title: Opposite finite stages present the opposite pair category
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, C_i categories and S a stage system with coherent transition associators. Form the stage system of opposite categories with transition (S.T h).op and inverse opposite associator. Its pair category is canonically equivalent to the opposite of S.PairCategory. The equivalence sends (i,op x) to op(i,x), and reverses the arrow of every common-stage representative, retaining its field and interchanging its two lower-bound witnesses.

proof.text: The inverse associator cocycle, after taking opposites, is exactly the required cocycle. Define the opposite stage system by this formula.

Reverse a representative by interchanging the two lower-bound witnesses and taking the opposite arrow. Expand transport: reversing swaps the two associators and inverts their roles, so eventual equality is preserved. Perform the same construction in the other direction.

Represent a composable pair at a common stage. Taking opposites reverses its composite, proving both functor laws. Reversing twice fixes every object and every representative, giving the identity-component unit and counit and hence the equivalence.
